==Description ==
The '''Goo''' is an enemy that appears in [[Polluted Wasteland II]]. It does not appear naturally and is instead spawned by the [[Super Slime]] upon its death. It has a high amount of health and a very fast speed. Upon death, the '''Goo''' will explode into a slime bubble that stuns all towers caught in it.

==Appearance==
The '''Goo''' is a faceless humanoid with a green skin color and a brown torso and legs. All of its body parts are encased in translucent green slime, which constantly emits green particles.

==Strategy==
*Use high DPS towers such as the [[Accelerator]], [[Ranger]], [[Pursuit]] and [[Engineer]] to defeat this enemy.
**The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be very useful at boosting the firerate and range of these towers.
*Towers that can damage multiple enemies, such as the [[Rocketeer]], [[Mortar]] and [[Electroshocker]] can be useful as multiple '''Goos''' spawn when the [[Super Slime]] is killed.
